Strategic Partnerships in the Fintech Ecosystem

Paycell CEO Serhat Dolaz, Doğuş Group Executive Esra Adalı Ayas, and Trendyol Group CFO Yasin Canki came together for a panel discussion at the Webrazzi Fintech 2025 conference. The panel discussed the integration of financial technologies within e-commerce and holding structures, as well as the development process over the past 10 years. Paycell announced that it had surpassed the 10-million-user milestone over the past decade and that its growth strategy is built on business partnerships.

Operational Efficiency and Data Analytics

Trendyol identified 2025 as a critical period in terms of operational strengthening and the digital transformation of SMEs. The focus was on the export and digital transformation processes of the more than 250,000 active sellers on the platform. Same-day delivery and streamlined return mechanisms were cited as key factors driving operational efficiency.

On the Doğuş Group side, amid a year marked by tight monetary policies and intense regulation, the focus was on technology investments. The group structured its strategy around the following areas:

  • AI-Powered Customer Experience: The use of AI-based designs in customer interactions.
  • Data Analytics: Data-driven management of campaigns and loyalty programs.
  • Transparent Pricing: A transparency policy addressing shifting consumer perceptions driven by macroeconomic conditions.

The Role and Future of Payment Infrastructure

The panel emphasized that payment systems are no longer merely a transaction tool but form the backbone of platforms. For Trendyol, the payment experience is described as the first point of contact with the customer. Users’ expectations for speed and security have led to an increase in card storage rates and the use of digital wallets.

The Doğuş Group noted that, thanks to the integration with Paycell, an end-to-end payment experience is provided, and the payment habit data collected generates insights for group companies. It is projected that speed, security, and transparency will continue to be the key determinants in payment systems in the coming period.
